eyebrow: Declaring the provider and its version
caption: features {} is required even when left empty.

code:
version = "3.80.0"   # exact -- brittle, blocks all updates
version = "~> 3.80"  # 3.80.x and later 3.x -- the common choice
version = ">= 3.0"   # any 3.x or later -- too loose for prod
caption: An unpinned provider can silently upgrade and break.
